description: Returns the Iron/Out UX Score (0 to 100) for one website, using real-user Chrome UX Report (CrUX) data from the last 28 days. The score is built on five Web Vitals: TTFB (10%), FCP (15%), LCP (25%), INP (25%) and CLS (25%). Use this when the user asks how fast or user-friendly a site is for real visitors. It does not run a lab test or Lighthouse and does not load the site. Sites with too little Chrome traffic have no CrUX data and return no score. If a monthly revenue band is given, it also estimates the revenue at stake. Returns a summary and a link to the full report.

language.description: Language of the linked report. Use nl when the user writes in Dutch.

monthlyRevenue.description: The site's monthly online revenue band. Only set this if the user said it. Never guess it.

url.description: Website or page to check, for example zalando.nl or https://www.example.com/. Use the shop domain visitors actually use (for example www2.hm.com).

name: run_ux_benchmark
title: Run UX benchmark
